title: Goodwill Days for the Time a Rate Lock Commitment Extension Dispute Waited
content:
**Lock desk concession on extension charge disputes: waiting time.**

Larkspur adds goodwill days to the relief days of a disputed **Rate Lock Commitment** extension for the time the dispute waited. The wait is the calendar days from the dispute's filing date to the date the decision is recorded.

**Rule.**

- When the decision is recorded more than **10** calendar days (the long-wait threshold) after the filing date, the long-wait goodwill of **2** days is added.
- When it is recorded more than **5** calendar days (the wait threshold) but no more than 10 calendar days after filing, the wait goodwill of **1** day is added.
- Otherwise none are added.

The relief days, these goodwill days included, are never below zero and never more than the disputed extension's charged days.

| Calendar days from filing to decision | Goodwill days |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | 0 |
| 6 to 10 | 1 |
| 11 or more | 2 |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical):* a dispute filed on 1 June and decided on 6 June has waited 5 days, so no goodwill is added. Decided on 7 June (6 days), it receives 1 day. Decided on 11 June (10 days), it still receives 1 day. Decided on 12 June (11 days), it receives 2 days.
